mapper.select: SELECT a.id AS "id", a.code AS "code", a.name_vi AS "nameVi", a.chapter AS "chapter" FROM diagnosis_catalog a WHERE a.del_flag = #{delFlag} AND (a.code LIKE #{pattern} ESCAPE '\\' OR a.name_vi LIKE #{pattern} ESCAPE '\\') ORDER BY a.code ASC LIMIT #{offset}, #{limit}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM diagnosis_catalog a WHERE a.del_flag = #{delFlag} AND (a.code LIKE #{pattern} ESCAPE '\\' OR a.name_vi LIKE #{pattern} ESCAPE '\\')
SELECT a.id AS "id", a.code AS "code", a.name_vi AS "nameVi", a.chapter AS "chapter" FROM diagnosis_catalog a WHERE a.id = #{diagnosisId} AND a.del_flag = #{delFlag}

SELECT a.id AS "id", a.code AS "code", a.name_vi AS "nameVi", a.chapter AS "chapter" FROM diagnosis_catalog a INNER JOIN diagnosis_pin p ON p.diagnosis_id = a.id WHERE p.doctor_id = #{doctorId} AND p.del_flag = '0' AND a.del_flag = #{delFlag} ORDER BY p.create_date DESC, a.code ASC
mapper.insert: INSERT IGNORE INTO diagnosis_pin( doctor_id, diagnosis_id, create_date, update_date, del_flag ) VALUES ( #{doctorId}, #{diagnosisId}, NOW(), NOW(), '0' )
